recognize_zh: 骨髓切片以脂肪為主、造血細胞僅呈細條狀分布在脂肪細胞之間，其中可見紅血球前驅細胞群（圓核深染）夾雜少數髓系細胞與巨核細胞；兒童全血球減少合併此種片狀低細胞性造血灶，符合兒童難治性血球減少症（refractory cytopenia of childhood）的切片表現。
features: Adipocyte-rich marrow with hematopoietic cells confined to thin cords and small interstitial foci
Foci dominated by erythroid precursors with round, dense, hyperchromatic nuclei (erythroid predominance)
Scattered myeloid precursors with more open chromatin and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional megakaryocytes present within the foci; no sheets of blasts
Interstitial extravasated red cells; no fibrosis, granulomas, or infiltrate evident at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, medium-high power) shows a fat-predominant field in which hematopoietic elements form thin interstitial cords and small patchy foci. The foci are composed predominantly of erythroid precursors with round hyperchromatic nuclei, admixed with fewer maturing myeloid cells and occasional megakaryocytes. No increase in blasts, lymphoid aggregates, granulomas, or metastatic cells is seen. In a child with pancytopenia, this patchy hypocellular hematopoiesis with erythroid predominance is consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, in the appropriate clinical and cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia usually shows markedly reduced or absent megakaryocytes and lacks the patchy erythroid islands with left-shifted maturation and megakaryocytic dysplasia typical of refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure syndrome (e.g., Fanconi anemia)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; chromosome breakage testing and germline sequencing are required to separate them.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular AML or MDS with excess blasts
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34-positive blasts (clusters or >5% aspirate blasts), which are not seen here.
